assumptions: Detection service is running and reachable at base_url.
Default rulebook from src/detection_service/rulebook.json is loaded.
Tests run in listed order to preserve stateful rule thresholds.
No authentication middleware is required for these endpoints in local mode.

single_request_tests.name: Single high-latency event should produce at least one detection signal
Deployment failed event should be detected
Batch detection should process all events and return aggregated signals
Invalid payload type for /detect should return validation error
Invalid payload type for /detect/batch should return validation error
Missing events key in batch payload should return empty result
Feedback without log_id should return business error
Feedback with log_id should be accepted
Labeled data endpoint should return count and sample list

stateful_scenarios.name: Brute force threshold test (5 failed logins from same IP)
stateful_scenarios.description: Rule brute_force_login should fire on the 5th auth.login_failed event for the same client_ip.

stateful_scenarios.name: Cache connection error threshold test (5 events)
stateful_scenarios.description: Rule cache_connection_error should fire on the 5th cache/redis connection error event inside the window.
